styles.css: .site-header { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; box-shadow: 1px 1px 5px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); z-index: 10; box-sizing: border-box; } .admin-bar .site-header { top: 32px; } @media screen and (max-width: 782px) { .admin-bar .site-header { top: 46px; } } .top-bar .top-bar-link a { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); text-decoration: none; margin: 5px 10px; display: block; cursor: pointer; } .top-bar .top-bar-link a:hover { color: #fff; } .top-bar-link--grow { flex: 1; } .page-header-cover { margin-top: 85px !important; margin-bottom: 0 !important; } .admin-bar .page-header-cover { margin-top: 117px !important; } @media screen and (max-width: 782px) { .admin-bar .page-header-cover { margin-top: 131px !important; } } .site-footer { margin-top: auto; } .site-footer a { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); } .site-footer a:hover { color: #fff; } .page-header-cover .wp-block-cover__inner-container { max-width: 835px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%; }
